title: Pennsylvania widow keeps $6,000 home after court rejects stepchildren's inheritance claim
summary_full: Jane L. Shellhammer, a widow from Pennsylvania, has successfully defended her right to remain in her family home following her husband's passing. Although his children attempted to lay claim to the property, the Pennsylvania Superior Court determined that the couple owned the house as tenants by the entirety. Consequently, Jane retains sole ownership of the Palmerton residence, a place she has cherished for over 45 years.
